scratch.buffer:
; Scratch buffer for live sequencer scripting.
; C-x C-e eval s-expression at cursor
; C-x C-b eval whole buffer
; C-q quit scratch
; Examples:
;   (seq-track-steps)
;   (for-each |n| (seq-toggle-step n) (list 1 5 9 13))
;   (every :bar 2 '(seq-toggle-step 1))
;   (clear-hooks)

(seq-track-steps)

(seq-effect-param-names 3)
(for-each |x| (seq-plock-effect x 3 2 0.812) (range 10 14))
(for-each |x| (seq-plock-timebase x :32) (range 8 16))
(for-each |x| (seq-plock-timebase x :2t) (range 13 15))

(seq-adjust-transpose 12 12)
